divergences.upstreamResult: scheduleTask queues registry work as a React Scheduler task at LowPriority, which Scheduler delivers in a MessageChannel message (setImmediate on Node).
divergences.octaneResult: scheduleTask posts the task in its own MessageChannel message (setTimeout where MessageChannel is absent): later than the current task and its microtasks, in order, and cancellable.
divergences.rationale: Octane has no Scheduler package; its own scheduler is not a public task queue. Registry work needs only an unclamped, cancellable later task.
divergences.consumerImpact: Registry work no longer yields to React Scheduler's higher-priority tasks, which Octane apps do not have. Custom scheduleTask options passed to RegistryProvider are used as before.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane exposes a public low-priority task API.

divergences.upstreamResult: The SSR cases server-render the test file's own components with react-dom/server and compare innerHTML with React's Suspense markers.
divergences.octaneResult: The server half renders server-compiled twins of the same components (tests/_fixtures/server.tsx), and the innerHTML comparisons drop comments. Every value, recoverable-error and hydration assertion is upstream.
divergences.rationale: One Octane test module compiles for either the client or the server, not both, and Octane's hydration comments are not React's.
divergences.consumerImpact: None: the server snapshot, hydration lock and SSR effect behavior are preserved.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review when the upstream SSR cases change.
